The GraphQL client residuals. web/gql.ts: `new AC({ uri })` through `import { ApolloClient as AC }` mints its transport ENDPOINT (an aliased import was unread), and the inline anonymous `gql`query { orders { id } }`` at the call site is the operation `orders` (its first root field) minted by the template scan alone: the needle no longer mints `graphql_op:client.query` beside it. web/ns.ts: `new Apollo.ApolloClient(..)` through `import * as Apollo`. web/urql.js: `const { createClient } = require('urql')` (minted since DT.11b c8673f13 through the file's package fallback; now decided by the destructure, counted `cjs=`; kept as a regression guard). web/graphql.module.ts: apollo-angular's `httpLink.create({ uri })` on a parameter typed as the imported HttpLink. web/wallet.ts: a document built by string concatenation and sent by an in-repo fetch wrapper (zora-protocol packages/cli/src/lib/agent/smart-wallet.ts's shape). web/upgrades.ts: graphql-request `request(url, gql`{ upgrades .. }`)`, an anonymous inline document at the call site (zora-protocol legacy/1155-deployments/script/getPendingUpgrades.ts's shape): no `graphql_op:request` beside `upgrades`. mobile/lib/orders.dart: `QueryOptions(document: listShipments)` built outside `client.query(options)`, the document passed by value (was `graphql_op:client.query`). api/graphql/app_schema.rb: graphql-ruby's schema `query Types::RootQuery` makes RootQuery the Query root (a name with no QueryType suffix named no root). The `OrdersQuery` type alias's SCHEMA_FIELDS shipped with FH.20 (896c3bed): a regression guard.
